concept: RDS Proxy and reserved concurrency: protecting the DB from Lambda
tests: How to survive Lambda checkout spikes without exhausting RDS connections.
expected: RDS Proxy pools connections; reserved concurrency caps concurrent Lambdas and protects downstream. Triggers: "flash-sale spikes", "Lambda", "connection exhaustion".
why_not: Disabling retries loses requests; a connection per invocation without pooling makes it worse; Single-AZ reduces availability.
